audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Ziggs Levels 2, 3 and 6 and called 4-5 and first item 'Skill', while the page's own why-strings say Kled out-trades from level 2, deletes an escape-less Ziggs at 3, out-sustains him at 4-5, knocks him out of position at 6 and peaks on first item. The page is also rated 'Hard matchup, difficulty 8.5/10' in a lane Kled wins 54.25% of the time.
audit.why: Ziggs has no dash. Once Kled is inside 550 units his only reset is Satchel Charge, a 20s cooldown at rank 1 — so every stage between level 2 and first item is Kled's, and Ziggs owns only Level 1 and the two-item artillery game.
audit.corrected: Levels 2 through First item flipped to Kled in both layers; difficulty lowered from 8.5/10 to 5/10 and the final rating line brought in line with the win rate.

audit.why: Kled: W at 2, full re-E at 3, R at 6, Eclipse first item. Ziggs: level 1 poke, Mega Inferno Bomb at 6 (120/95/70s), two items of range and slow.

audit.whatIsWrong: Satchel Charge is called 'his knockback + self-peel escape' with no cooldown, and Short Fuse — the reason his poke lands harder the more he casts — is absent from the page entirely.
audit.why: Satchel Charge is 20/18/16/14/12s, so at rank 1 baiting it buys 20 seconds with no escape in his kit at all. Short Fuse (P) is an auto-attack reset whose cooldown drops every time he casts an ability, so his hardest single hit follows a bomb, not precedes it — the attack wind-up after a cast is the tell. Hexplosive Minefield (E), 16s flat, only slows: it does not stop the E dash once you are inside.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns and the Short Fuse tell written into the cooldown and interaction fields.

edits.before: - Ziggs Satchel Charge: matchup-defining — His knockback + self-peel escape. Engage when it's down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Satchel Charge (W), 20s at rank 1: his only escape, and he has no dash. Bait it and he cannot leave. - Hexplosive Minefield (E), 16s, only slows — it does not stop your dash once you are inside. - Short Fuse (P) recharges faster every time he casts.

edits.before: Track Ziggs's Satchel Charge: His knockback + self-peel escape. Engage when it's down. When it is down — Q-trap + courage all-in.
edits.after: Satchel Charge (W) is 20s at rank 1 and it is his whole escape — bait it, then he is stuck. Minefield only slows. Short Fuse resets on every cast, so his big auto follows a bomb: step back on that wind-up.

edits.before: That is Ziggs's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.

notes: The chart handed Ziggs five of seven stages in a lane Kled wins 54.25%, and the difficulty was set to 8.5/10 with a red tone against the same data — both corrected. One data caution: Satchel Charge carries a derived 'percentHealth' flag, but Riot's description says only magic damage plus a knockback, so no max-health claim was written and armour/MR advice was left as it stands.
